build_memory_manager: build a MemoryManager to orchestrate a built-in memory provider plus one external plugin memory provider
create_add_provider: create and register a memory provider with MemoryManager, allowing only one external provider at a time
test_prefetch_all: test prefetching memory context from all registered providers given a query string and optional session id
refactor_handle_tool_call: refactor MemoryManager to route a tool call to the correct registered memory provider by tool name
summarize_build_system_prompt: summarize how MemoryManager builds a combined system prompt from all registered providers
